summary: This dataset describes a study comparing dosimetric differences between intraoperative radiotherapy (IORT), pre-operative single-fraction stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS), and post-operative external beam radiotherapy (EBRT) in glioblastoma patients. Imaging series of previously treated patients were analyzed using pre-operative MRIs and planning CT scans to define target volumes for SRS and IORT. The study evaluated dose prescription, target coverage, and doses to organs-at-risk (OARs) such as the brain, optic nerve, and retina.
